clips.title: The story
paras: Outside Northshire Abbey, Eagan Peltskinner has work for recruits as timber wolves threaten the valley. The local furrier needs hunters to thin the packs and bring back pelts.

Deputy Willem often sends recruits from the abbey to find Eagan Peltskinner, who works nearby on its grounds. Northshire Valley's orchards and fields lie beside wild woods where timber wolves prowl. Eagan wants newcomers to hunt the aggressive packs and gather pelts for his craft.

Timber wolves threaten workers, acolytes, and supplies moving in and out of Northshire. Sending young champions to Eagan helps keep nearby paths safe while sparing Stormwind's few remaining guards. They are already occupied by rising tensions across Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Eagan Peltskinner is looking for someone to hunt wolves for him. That's good news, because we're seeing a lot more wolves in Northshire Valley lately.
If you're interested then speak with Eagan. He's around the side of the abbey, to the left.

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's true. I'm looking for someone to hunt me some wolves! Are you that person?
